skill.name: canvas-design
skill.description: Create static visual artwork by first defining a design philosophy, then producing PNG or PDF canvas outputs with strong composition, sparse text and typography guidance.
skill.summary: Generate design philosophies and polished PNG or PDF canvas artwork from short creative briefs.
skill.author: ComposioHQ

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Open Font License text, Markdown formatting, and design guidance. Bundled font binaries were manually checked as loadable TrueType assets, but the skill also instructs models to download arbitrary fonts. No evidence found of credential theft, data exfiltration, or prompt injection aimed at the audit process.

remediation.suggestion: Remove the instruction to download whatever fonts are needed. Require bundled vetted fonts or explicit user approval for each external source.
Add a font inventory with source URLs, licenses, and hashes so reviewers can verify the packaged binary assets.

content.value_statement: Static design requests often need clear artistic direction before production. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to create visual philosophies, PNG artwork, and PDF canvas outputs.
actual_capabilities: Creates a written visual philosophy before image production.
Guides single-page PNG or PDF canvas artwork.
Encourages sparse text, strong composition, and careful typography.
Uses bundled local fonts from the canvas-fonts directory.
Supports multi-page visual sets when the user asks.
limitations: Does not provide executable rendering code by itself.
Bundled fonts add binary assets that marketplaces may review separately.
Design quality depends on the host model and available rendering tools.
It does not verify trademark or brand usage rights.

use_cases.title: Commission Abstract Posters
use_cases.description: Create a visual philosophy and final canvas for an event, product, or personal theme.

use_cases.title: Develop Campaign Art
use_cases.description: Turn a short campaign idea into a refined PNG or PDF with controlled typography and composition.

use_cases.title: Build Editorial Visuals
use_cases.description: Create art-forward page concepts for magazines, essays, or presentation covers.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Poster
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a one-page PNG poster for [topic]. Develop the visual philosophy first, then create the final canvas.

prompt_templates.title: Refine a Style
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a visual philosophy for [theme] using [mood], [colors], and sparse text. Output a PNG and the philosophy file.

prompt_templates.title: Produce a Multi-Page Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a three-page PDF series for [subject]. Make each page distinct, cohesive, and based on one shared visual philosophy.

prompt_templates.title: Translate a Brand Concept
prompt_templates.prompt: Translate [brand or project] into a museum-quality visual system. Use subtle references, local fonts, and strict canvas boundaries.

output_examples.input: Create a poster for a quiet jazz listening night.
output_examples.output: A concise philosophy named Chromatic Silence, plus a restrained PNG poster with minimal labels and balanced negative space.

output_examples.input: Make a PDF cover for an essay about urban memory.
output_examples.output: A single-page PDF cover with layered geometry, sparse type, and a separate markdown file explaining the visual philosophy.

output_examples.input: Design a three-page visual set for a ceramics studio launch.
output_examples.output: A cohesive PDF series with distinct pages, local font choices, controlled margins, and refined abstract composition.

best_practices: Provide the subject, mood, output format, and any required text.
Keep required copy short so the canvas can stay visual.
Review generated files for text boundaries, font fit, and page margins.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for large blocks of explanatory text inside the artwork.
Do not request imitation of a living artist or protected brand style.
Do not combine many unrelated themes in one canvas.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates a visual philosophy, then guides production of PNG or PDF canvas artwork.

faq.question: Can it use custom fonts?
faq.answer: It points the model to bundled local fonts and suggests varied typography when text is needed.

faq.question: Does it create code?
faq.answer: No. The skill focuses on visual design outputs, not application code or scripts.

faq.question: Is it suitable for commercial work?
faq.answer: It can support concept art, but users should review licenses, brands, and final rights.

faq.question: Can it make multiple pages?
faq.answer: Yes. The instructions include a multi-page option when the user requests a series or PDF.

faq.question: What tools can run it?
faq.answer: It is listed for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code in the marketplace report.
